$comment: How many routes currently have a screen guide.
A RATCHET, and it points both ways — the same discipline src/tokens/baseline.js
applies to contrast defects. Coverage may not fall: deleting a guide, or adding a
route without one, fails the check. And when you DO write a guide, the check fails
until you raise this number, so the count cannot quietly stay stale.
It is not 22 yet because writing 19 more guides at the standard the three reference
guides set is real work, and a gate nobody can pass is a gate everybody disables.
